children: Flag Ship Acquisition entered into a definitive merger agreement with Bluechip & Co. Holdings for a two-step SPAC business combination valued at $400 million. Bluechip shareholders will receive 40,000,000 purchaser ordinary shares at $10.00 per share, with the target to become a wholly owned subsidiary following sequential SPAC and acquisition mergers. The purchaser is expected to list on the Nasdaq Capital Market, and Bluechip will provide non-interest-bearing expense loans to cover transaction costs. Additional related agreements include executed shareholder support agreements and planned amended registration rights and lock-up agreements to facilitate closing and post-merger trading.
